passages.text: Then we re-purpose a multi- domain summarization dataset and verify how the gap between different domains inﬂuences the performance of neural summarization mod- els. Furthermore, we investigate four learning strategies and examine their abilities to deal with the domain shift problem. Experimental results on three different settings show their different characteristics in our new testbed.
